portal.tablets.title: Site tablets
portal.support.title: Support access
portal.support.description: Let Karry support look at your company's data to help you, and see when it did.
portal.support.ruleReadOnly: Look only: support cannot change anything.
portal.support.ruleMasked: Costs, prices and other protected values stay hidden.
portal.support.ruleHour: For one hour at most; you can end it at any time.
portal.support.ruleAudit: Everything support opens is recorded in the audit log.
portal.support.ruleEmergency: Without your code, only in an emergency, with a written reason: your administrators are e-mailed at once.
portal.support.none: Karry support has not looked at your company yet
portal.support.endHint: Karry support loses access at once. It can look again only with a new code or in an emergency.
portal.support.createHint: The code lets Karry support look at your company for one hour. Create it only when Karry support asks for it, on a call you trust.
portal.support.codeHint: Read this code to Karry support. It works once.
portal.support.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one if Karry support still needs it.
portal.tablets.description: Each tablet is added for one site and works offline. A lost tablet is revoked here.
portal.tablets.enrolHint: Choose the site of the tablet. You get a code valid 15 minutes, for one tablet.
portal.tablets.codeHint: On the tablet, scan this QR code or type the code. It works once, for 15 minutes.
portal.tablets.name: Tablet
portal.tablets.qr: QR code to add the tablet
portal.tablets.code: Code to type on the tablet
portal.tablets.step1: On the tablet, open the Karry field app at your company's address.
portal.tablets.step2: Choose “Add this tablet”, then scan the QR code or type the code.
portal.tablets.step3: Give the tablet a name. It appears in the list once added.
portal.tablets.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one.
portal.tablets.revokeHint: The tablet stops working at once. What it already sent stays; what it sends later is kept for review and never processed. To use it again, add it with a new code.
